caption:

My simple morning bowl 🤎

• ¾ cup plain Greek yogurt

• 1 scoop Vital Proteins Chocolate Collagen Peptides

• ⅓ cup fresh berries

• ¼ cup granola

• 1 tbsp chia seeds or nut butter

• Drizzle of pure maple syrup

That’s it - simple, yummy and easy to fit into a busy morning. This is just a small daily habit that helps me nourish my body and feel my best from the inside out! #ad #vitalproteinscanada #vitalproteins #collagendrink #collagen

caption:
We’re halfway through the year and if there’s one thing I’ve realized, it’s that you don’t need to become a new person. Maybe you just need to return to what feels good. I have to say that something I’ve learned in my 40s is that feminine energy comes from feeling connected to yourself again.

After years of raising kids, taking care of everyone else and carrying the mental load of it all, I realized I had drifted away from the version of me that felt calm and at fully at ease.🥲

Getting back to her hasn’t looked like doing more, it has looked like:

• trusting my intuition
• setting boundaries without guilt
• not seeking external validation
• surrounding myself with emotionally healthy people
• choosing friendships that bring peace
• letting go of what I can’t control
• allowing things to unfold instead of forcing them
• not overexplaining my decisions
• making time for the people and things that bring me joy
• prioritizing my well-being, not just everyone else’s

Because I’ve learned that the more I take care of myself, the more I show up as the woman, wife and mom I want to be.

Maybe that’s been the real shift of my 40s ... not finding feminine energy, but learning to protect it.

Sorry for the long post here, but July already has me in my feels. If you got this far, then maybe this is your reminder too … that you don’t have to reinvent yourself for the second half of the year. Maybe you just need to come home to the version of you that feels the most like you.

caption:
I can’t believe we’re celebrating 18 years married today. 🥹🤍

To celebrate, here are 18 random facts about us and our journey together:

1. This first photo was taken when we first met. I was only 14! We stayed friends and didn’t reconnect and start dating until university.

2. Emil got my attention by throwing a baseball my way at a park. ⚾️

3. Emil was away at university on a soccer scholarship in Detroit, so we spent years doing the long-distance thing. ⚽️

4. There were a lot of love letters and a few breaks in between, but we always found our way back to each other and put in the work.

5. Emil proposed at the very same park where we met as teenagers. 🥹

6. We had a dog named Vegas, who passed away a few years ago. He’ll always be a special part of our story. 🐾

7. We got married in Toronto and had our reception at Atlantis with 300+ guests. If you remember the revolving dance floor, you know. 😂

8. Emil is definitely the more outgoing and social one, while I’m much more introverted. Somehow it works.

9. We did couples therapy earlier in our marriage and so glad that we did.

10. Emil always wanted lots of kids. I thought I only one. We went through a lot trying for a second, including two miscarriages, and it still makes me cry thinking about it.

11. He’s the chef of the house and claims my food is “too clean.” 🍽️

12. We’ve traveled to nearly 20 countries together. ✈️

13. One of us works out a lot more than the other. 👀

14. Emil grew up in a more traditional Filipino home and has brought many of those traditions into our family. 🇵🇭

15. This guy has over 600 unread emails. I have zero. 😅

16. His love language is physical touch and mine is words of affirmation.

17. Emil has our anniversary date tattooed on him... I don’t. 🤣

18. After 18 years, two daughters, the best memories and all of the highs and lows, we continue to choose each other over and over again. 🤍

Happy 18 years to us!

#ad After 6+ years with my Peloton Bike, I’ve officially added the Cross Training Tread into my routine! The way I train is evolving- I’m all about more personalized workouts that match where I’m at now … strength, low-impact runs and walks, recovery and mindfulness, all in one place.

In my 40s, that flexibility matters more than ever. It’s no longer about one-size-fits-all … it’s about training with intention. Peloton just gets it, and I love this for me 🤍
